title: Nano Banana 2.1 halves the price of an AI image. Read the fine print.

say: Google's new image model, Nano Banana 2.1, makes pictures for about half the price.
On the Gemini API, a 1K image drops from 6.7 cents to about 3.4.
A 2K image, from about 10 cents to 5.
Input now costs a dollar fifty per million tokens, three times as much.
Text and thinking output rose from three dollars to seven fifty.
So if you send lots of reference images or long prompts, you'll save less than the headline suggests.
Small text often stays blurry at 1K, and the model sometimes mixes up left and right.
Independent tests aren't out yet. Cheaper pictures, pricier words.

ticker: READ THE FINE PRINT — CHEAPER PICTURES — PRICIER WORDS
